items.title: Reused receipt images in expense claims: a detection and review protocol
items.excerpt: A source-backed method for screening duplicate and near-duplicate receipt images in client expense claims without turning a candidate into an accusation.

items.title: Who owns the bank account? Testing entity-account evidence before a multi-entity close
items.excerpt: A source-backed method for testing whether each bank account can be tied to a legal entity, a reporting period, and a reviewable source before the books are consolidated.
